description: Verified tactics database for AI Transformation Readiness synthesis. Each tactic maps a detected readiness gap or anti-pattern to a solution mechanism.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Establish an AI operating rhythm with decision-rights matrix, intake cadence, risk triage, service-area accountability, decision log, and escalation boundaries.
tactics.case_study: READY-AND-ADAPT OPERATING RHYTHM: Connects strategy, demand capture, governance, delivery, and shared learning so AI value creation becomes traceable operating work.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Classify AI demand by predictability, uncertainty, risk, value, data readiness, and service ownership. Route standardized work through repeatable delivery and iterative work through Launch-and-Learn slices.
tactics.case_study: ADAPTIVE DEMAND ROUTING: Separates standardized automation from exploratory AI so impact-driven work is not forced into fixed-scope delivery.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Run a Kickstart diagnostic and bounded vertical slice with impact statement, learning goals, production-readiness criteria, safety evidence, and a conversion path into reusable patterns.
tactics.case_study: KICKSTART LAUNCH-AND-LEARN: Validates a service-area slice, proves value and safety, and produces a pilot AI playbook before Building-the-System scaling.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Create communities of knowledge, incident reviews, failure libraries, reusable playbooks, and cross-functional learning rituals that convert pilots into shared capability.
tactics.case_study: SHARED LEARNING SYSTEM: Converts pilot lessons, red-team findings, data issues, and operating incidents into practices shared across business, data, platform, and service teams.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Redesign roles, handoffs, review points, human-in-the-loop responsibilities, exception paths, and experience metrics before scaling AI into work.
tactics.case_study: KNOWLEDGE AUGMENTATION: Moves capacity toward higher-value work and measures quality, decision quality, cognitive load, and customer impact after AI introduction.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Expose brownfield and legacy systems through governed APIs, events, service boundaries, connector standards, versioning, ownership, and failure-mode documentation.
tactics.case_study: BROWNFIELD VIABILITY: Wraps legacy systems through service boundaries so AI can connect without breaking the operational core.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Version models, prompts, agents, tools, datasets, configs, and evaluation suites through build-test-deploy-monitor-rollback controls.
tactics.case_study: AI LIFECYCLE CONTROL: Makes production behavior traceable to release, prompt, tool, model, data, and evaluation versions.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Define offline and online evaluation, drift checks, groundedness tests, safety thresholds, value metrics, retraining triggers, and service-owner alert workflows.
tactics.case_study: SENSE & RESPOND LOOP: Treats models as living agents whose quality, safety, cost, latency, and business impact must trigger learning or intervention.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Define forbidden actions, data boundaries, tool permissions, Human-in-the-Loop escalation matrix, adversarial red-team tests, and human override for agents and AI workflows.
tactics.case_study: SECURE-BY-DESIGN: Embeds Agent Behavioral Contracts, prompt-injection testing, and escalation boundaries into service design instead of relying on late-stage review.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Offer model gateways, reusable data-access patterns, deployment templates, evaluation services, observability, and developer experience as internal products for service-area teams.
tactics.case_study: PLATFORM-AS-PRODUCT: Platform teams serve service-area teams as internal customers and measure adoption, reliability, flow, cognitive load reduction, and value enablement.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Define why AI matters, where it creates value, where not to use it, and how ambition areas map to services and value streams.
tactics.case_study: PURPOSE-DRIVEN AI: Converts generic AI enthusiasm into strategic choices, boundaries, and service-area focus.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Require impact statements, evidence-based business cases, baselines, value hypotheses, and post-release measurement for AI initiatives before scale decisions.
tactics.case_study: IMPACT BEFORE OUTPUT: Routes AI opportunities by measurable customer, quality, flow, risk, ROCE/TVO, or adaptability impact rather than tool novelty or TCO fixation.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Assign service/domain owners for AI-critical data products with quality accountability, definitions, semantic context, access rules, lifecycle, and usage expectations.
tactics.case_study: DATA AS FUEL: Data owners preserve service meaning so AI decisions are grounded in context instead of raw signals.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.canonical_name: AI Data Quality and Lineage Control
tactics.solution_mechanism: Catalog and version AI-critical data, assess data readiness levels, monitor freshness and completeness, and trace training, retrieval, inference, and decision data.
tactics.case_study: DATA READINESS LEVELS: Makes AI outputs explainable through source, version, quality, semantic richness, and freshness evidence.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.problem_pattern: Ad hoc retrieval and duplicate knowledge stores
tactics.solution_mechanism: Define governed RAG, embedding, search, feature, event-stream, source coverage, freshness, contextual grounding, and retrieval-quality patterns for reuse.
tactics.case_study: GROUNDING PATTERNS: Treats retrieval quality and source coverage as data-access architecture rather than a model-only problem.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Map customer journey, frontstage work, backstage work, systems, data, decisions, air gaps, failure modes, bottlenecks, and ownership before placing AI interventions.
tactics.case_study: AI SERVICE BLUEPRINTING: Anchors AI opportunities in service blueprints, value streams, and service-area ownership before solution build.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.canonical_name: Service Area Team Model and Scaling Playbook
tactics.solution_mechanism: Sequence Building-the-System scaling by service readiness, data ownership, architecture clarity, risk level, integrated team model, reusable patterns, and readiness reassessment.
tactics.case_study: SERVICE AREA TEAM MODEL: Converts Kickstart learning into guardrails, playbooks, templates, platform capabilities, and integrated ownership before expansion.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
